name: space-tracker-size-split
description: Per-sequence small / large object split for the Space-tracker SOT and MOT manifests.

criterion.definition: median over all GT boxes in the sequence of sqrt(w * h) in pixels
criterion.note: COCO's small-object threshold (area <= 32*32). Sequence-level assignment by the median keeps sequences that merely jitter across the threshold out of the small bucket.
